answer_1.quote: Our key technical challenge is to predict open-ended responses, i.e., generate predicted student code... We fine-tune a base GPT-2 generative model into a text-to-code model PΘ with parameter Θ on code data...
answer_1.outputs: Generated student code snippets for programming questions

answer_2.quote: we use two metrics, including CodeBLEU (Ren et al., 2020), a variant of the classic BLEU metric adapted to code... The other metric is the average test loss across code tokens... we also use the dist-N metric ... we choose N = 1 in this work
